items.title: From April 1983 to Feb. 1984, Magic Johnson dished out 10+ assists in 46 straight games, a record that has yet to be broken.
items.author: NBA Stat
items.body_excerpt:
From April 1983 to Feb. 1984, Magic Johnson dished out 10+ assists in 46 straight games, a record that has yet to be broken.

John Stockton (in 1989) and Rajon Rondo (in 2012) have come the closest, each recording double-digit assists in 37 consecutive games.

(via CrazyStats)
#NBA
